capabilities: Sync the vault across devices through a private GitHub repo
Connect a GitHub account using OAuth device flow
Resolve conflicting edits with a side-by-side Keep Mine / Keep Theirs modal
Show sync state in the status bar and trigger manual syncs
Exclude files and folders from syncing with wildcard patterns
disambiguation: Not a general Git version-control plugin for making manual commits; it uses Git only as the engine to sync the vault across devices.
extras: Most of the README covers building from source (Node.js, npm, registering a GitHub OAuth App); end users can install via BRAT. Uses isomorphic-git so no native binary is needed on mobile, and stores the GitHub token only in local plugin data. Repo soft limit of 1 GB noted.
intentEvidence: It's designed to replace, not complement, Obsidian Sync. Using both at once is not recommended
problem: Syncing a vault across devices normally requires a paid service or self-managed servers; this gives free cross-device sync using only the user's own GitHub account.

relations.evidence: It's designed to replace, not complement, Obsidian Sync.

summary: Vault sync service that automatically commits and pushes changes to your own private GitHub repo and pulls them on every desktop and mobile device.
